meta.title: [Cursor] Fix some bugs
meta.body_summary: Fix router memory leaks via timeout cleanup and improve case sensitivity consistency in route path matching.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor PR fixing memory leaks and case sensitivity but lacking tests; CI failed and closed after inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 558 changed lines across 3 files, this is a medium-sized bugfix by absolute volume, with most churn in router.ts (498 lines) from automated fixes. As a multi-fix PR with memory leak claim it was closed without merge after CI failure and lack of tests.

core_change_summary.description: Modified router.ts for timeout cleanup (memory leak fix) and path.ts for case-insensitive prefix/suffix matching; also added XSS validation in ScriptOnce.tsx.
